assets.prompt: Create a minimalist premium photographic illustration for a digital studio service card. Landscape 3:2, matte uniform charcoal #222 background. ONE physically realistic modern graphite device, restrained soft lighting, small contact shadow, very few elements. Device is in the LOWER 65 percent of the composition, leaving the upper 35 percent empty charcoal for the website title overlay. Complete hardware and all corners visible within frame. Slightly angled, not dramatically tilted. No props, furniture, glass ribbons, pedestals, exploded components, machinery, cubes, plants, rocks, ornamental sci-fi, text outside screen, neon, heavy reflections or gradients. Screen is a calm clear designed interface, white/light gray with dark typography and tiny muted blue accents, minimal readable labels. Beautiful proportions and believable real hardware. A thin graphite laptop displaying a refined editorial architecture website, big monochrome building photograph on left, brief typography on right, generous white space. Keyboard visible. No floating panels.
